name: pvz-web
description: 网页版植物大战僵尸 — 纯前端 Canvas 实现，零运行时依赖，可部署到 Cloudflare Pages

scripts.test: node tools/smoke-test.cjs . && node tools/dom-test.cjs . && node tools/browser-test.cjs .
scripts.deploy: npx --yes wrangler pages deploy site --project-name pvz-web
scripts.deploy:preview: npx --yes wrangler pages deploy site --project-name pvz-web --branch preview
